verdict.rationale: Numeral documents a first-party refunds endpoint that attaches refunds to previously recorded transactions, plus refund reversals and a calculate → commit → refund lifecycle. Recorded transactions feed its filing service, so refunds plausibly flow into returns, but no evidence explicitly says refund amounts reduce liability or carry into reporting and the next filing. missing for 10: explicit documentation that refunds adjust liability, reporting and subsequent filings automatically; credit-note support; negative-amount handling; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, refunds and credit notes adjust tax correctly — negative amounts flow through liability, reporting, and the next filing without manual journal fixes
